data.name: Raoom
data.gender_notes: Raoom is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic roots ‘Ra’ (sun) and ‘Mim’ (moon), this name signifies the beauty and harmony of the sun and moon. The name Raoom carries the meaning “Sun and Moon” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Raoom usually hope their child will grow to embody sun and moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the balance and harmony between the sun and the moon, representing enlightenment and inner peace.
data.etymology: Raoom belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sun and Moon.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raoom total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
data.cultural_impact: The association of ‘Ra’ and ‘Mim’ with the sun and moon represents a deep reverence for nature and its cycles, as expressed in Islamic culture. The name could evoke memories of poetic verses about Allah’s creation, the passing of time, and the cyclical order of the universe.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the sun and moon symbolize the manifestation of Allah’s infinite power and grace. They are reminders of the constancy of Allah’s presence and the importance of submission to His will. Thus, the name 'Raoom' encourages a connection with Allah through the marvels of His creation, offering a constant reminder of His majesty and love.
